categories.main_business_segments: Zenkoku Hosho Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the credit guarantee business, with a particular focus on housing loan guarantees. The company and its consolidated subsidiaries form a group that provides credit guarantees for housing loans, card loans, and educational loans, as well as related services such as debt collection and credit management. The group is structured as a single business segment centered on credit guarantees.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core operational methods involve rigorous credit screening, risk assessment, and guarantee underwriting for housing loans and related financial products. It utilizes proprietary credit evaluation systems, risk management frameworks, and a robust process for managing guarantee liabilities and recourse claims. The company also leverages IT systems for efficient guarantee processing and risk monitoring.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Zenkoku Hosho's main customers are individual borrowers seeking housing loans, as well as financial institutions such as banks, credit unions, and agricultural cooperatives that require external credit guarantees for their lending activities. The company serves the Japanese housing loan market, supporting both new and refinancing loans, and also provides guarantees for card loans and educational loans.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates nationwide across Japan, with a network of branches and subsidiaries covering all major regions, including Hokkaido, Tohoku, Kanto, Chubu, Kansai, Chugoku, Shikoku, and Kyushu. There is no significant overseas business; all operations and assets are concentrated within Japan.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zenkoku Hosho functions as a midstream service provider in the financial services supply chain, acting as an intermediary between financial institutions (upstream) and individual borrowers (downstream) by assuming credit risk through guarantees. The company does not originate loans but provides risk mitigation for lenders.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus is on expanding its core housing loan guarantee business, increasing market share through both organic growth (new contracts with financial institutions) and inorganic growth (M&A of other guarantee companies). It aims to build a comprehensive housing loan platform, diversify into adjacent businesses such as debt collection, and enhance ESG initiatives, including human capital development and climate risk management. R&D spending is minimal, with emphasis on product development and operational system improvements.
categories.revenue_model: Zenkoku Hosho generates revenue primarily through guarantee fees paid by borrowers or financial institutions. Fees are collected either as a lump sum at the start of the guarantee period or as recurring payments based on the outstanding loan balance. The company also earns income from investment of received guarantee fees and from debt collection activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with bank-affiliated guarantee companies and other independent credit guarantee providers in Japan. Zenkoku Hosho differentiates itself as an independent, non-bank-affiliated entity with nationwide coverage and a diversified client base, reducing dependence on any single financial institution or region. It is a leading player in the independent segment of the Japanese credit guarantee market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated operating revenue was 56.97 billion yen, with net income attributable to parent company shareholders of 32.09 billion yen. Total assets reached 492.4 billion yen, and the company employed 369 people (consolidated). The company has demonstrated steady growth in revenue, profit, and guarantee balances, with a target to reach 21 trillion yen in guarantee balances and 14% ROE by March 2026.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zenkoku Hosho offers a unique value proposition as an independent, nationwide credit guarantee provider not tied to any specific financial institution, enabling broad risk diversification and flexible partnerships. Its comprehensive guarantee products, competitive fee structures, and robust risk management systems allow financial institutions to reduce credit risk and borrowers to access loans without the need for personal guarantors. The company emphasizes operational reliability, customer-centric service, and innovation in guarantee product development.
